reviews.summary: SOON has a recurring vesting schedule: a 2% of total-supply unlock was scheduled for September 23, 2026, seven days before this snapshot, with another 2% scheduled October 23. This creates near-term supply/volatility risk.
materialRisks: A scheduled 20.2M SOON release on September 23, 2026 represented 2.0% of total supply and about 3.5% of market cap; it falls within the last 7 days of the signal snapshot. ([app.tokenomics.com](https://app.tokenomics.com/tokenomics/soon/unlocks?utm_source=openai))

The next scheduled release is 20.2M SOON on October 23, 2026—also 2.0% of total supply and about 3.4% of market cap—maintaining an identifiable supply-overhang event risk. ([app.tokenomics.com](https://app.tokenomics.com/tokenomics/soon/unlocks?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: Kraken’s status page identifies SOON as the Solana-based SOON asset and currently marks it operational; no SOON-specific exchange outage or halt was reported in the recent status history reviewed. ([status.kraken.com](https://status.kraken.com/?utm_source=openai))

Kraken’s planned October 1, 2026 spot website/API maintenance is exchange-wide and scheduled for 07:01–07:16 UTC; markets may briefly transition through cancel-only and post-only modes after maintenance. ([krakenfx.statuspage.io](https://krakenfx.statuspage.io/?utm_source=openai))
No SOON delisting appears in Kraken’s currently published August 2026 delisting notice. ([support.kraken.com](https://support.kraken.com/articles/asset-delistings-august-2026?utm_source=openai))
